title: Running Vacuum in the expanding Universe: a unified QFT paradigm for Inflation and Dark Energy
summary: The concordance $Λ$CDM model, based on a rigid $Λ$-term for the entire cosmic history, has been in crisis for a long time. In our expanding Universe, an evolving $Λ$ with the expansion is intuitively much more reasonable. In the running vacuum model (RVM) framework, based on quantum field theory (QFT) in curved spacetime, quantum effects induce a vacuum energy density (VED) $ρ_{\rm vac}=Λ/(8πG)$ which is a function of the Hubble rate $H$ and its time derivatives, $ρ_{\rm vac}=ρ_{\rm vac}(H, \dot{H},\ddot{H},\dots)$.
